versions.changelog:
- Added "Start on APIDot" section to clarify core entry points for users coming from ClawHub.
- Removed "skill-card.md" file for a simpler, single-file documentation approach.
- No logic, functional, or integration changes were made; remains documentation-only.

Initial release of APIDot Model Catalog API skill.

- Provides guidance for choosing and routing to live APIDot model pages for image, video, chat, music, and 3D workflows.
- Outlines strict security best practices for API key management and sensitive data.
- Includes a clear catalog routing table and skill routing hierarchy for integrating the right APIDot resource.
- Documentation-only: contains no executable code, scripts, or bundled API clients.
- Offers official links to APIDot docs, model pages, quickstart, and support resources.
